about.title: About HospitiumRIS
about.mission_desc: To empower healthcare institutions with integrated digital tools that streamline research management, enhance collaboration, and drive impactful outcomes.
about.vision_desc: A future where every hospital and health research institution operates with the efficiency and intelligence of world-class research organisations.
about.researchers_desc: Tools to manage publications, collaborate, and track research impact.
about.managers_desc: Oversight tools for managing teams, projects, budgets, and compliance.
about.foundation_desc: Grant management, fundraising, and donor relationship tools.
about.hero_subtitle: HospitiumRIS is a healthcare-focused Research Information System designed to help hospitals, medical schools, and health research organisations manage the entire research lifecycle through a centralized digital infrastructure.
about.what_is_desc: HospitiumRIS (Research Information System) is an integrated digital infrastructure designed to manage, track, monitor, and showcase the entire research lifecycle in hospitals and health research institutions. It enables seamless coordination between clinicians, researchers, ethics committees, funders, and regulators through one centralized and secure platform.
about.solution_p3: Global visibility via ORCID, Crossref & DataCite
about.value_innovative_desc: Leveraging cutting-edge technology and AI to transform hospital research management.
about.value_centralized_desc: One unified platform for the entire research lifecycle — from proposal to publication.
about.value_proactive_desc: Anticipating institutional needs and enabling data-driven research excellence.
about.benefits_subtitle: What HospitiumRIS delivers for your institution
about.benefit_admin_desc: Centralize research administration and ethics workflows — reducing manual processes and administrative burden.
about.benefit_visibility_desc: Showcase publications, datasets, and researcher profiles globally to strengthen your institution's academic reputation.
about.benefit_data_desc: Leverage analytics dashboards for citation metrics, research trends, and departmental performance reporting.
about.benefit_collab_desc: Connect researchers, funders, ethics committees, and regulatory bodies on a single secure platform.
about.benefit_compliance_desc: Built-in ethics tracking, audit trails, and compliance workflows for regulatory-ready research governance.
about.benefit_secure_desc: Enterprise-grade access controls, data protection workflows, and governance structures you can trust.
about.who_uses_subtitle: Built for the full spectrum of health research institutions — from small research units to national referral hospitals.
about.role_manager_desc: Oversee institutional research activities, manage workflows, and monitor research output with comprehensive analytics dashboards.
about.role_researchers_desc: Manage publications, track projects, conduct research, and ensure compliance & ethics approvals through an integrated researcher portal.
about.role_foundation_desc: Coordinate grants, manage fundraising campaigns, track donors, and measure the impact of research investments.
about.developed_by_subtitle: A product of open infrastructure and research visibility expertise
about.tcc_desc1: TCC Africa is a leading African research communication and capacity-building organisation based at the University of Nairobi. It supports African and Global South researchers, institutions, and publishers to improve research quality, visibility, and impact through training, tools, and open infrastructure.
about.tcc_desc2: HospitiumRIS was developed as part of TCC Africa's broader mission to advance Open Infrastructure and research visibility for health institutions across Africa and the Global South.
about.cta_subtitle: Join hospitals, universities, and research institutes building data-driven research ecosystems with HospitiumRIS.

about_foundation_manager.hero_subtitle: HospitiumRIS is a digital research management platform that transforms hospitals into hubs of credible, measurable, and impactful research. It equips institutions with the tools to document, monitor, and report research excellence — empowering clinicians and administrators to improve care, demonstrate outcomes, and unlock further funding with confidence.
about_foundation_manager.f1_intro: HospitiumRIS provides hospitals with a fully integrated digital infrastructure to organize, track, and elevate research activity from ideation to publication. It captures key elements such as:
about_foundation_manager.f1_why1: Generates evidence that powers improved healthcare delivery and policy decisions
about_foundation_manager.f1_why2: Supports context specific solutions instead of imported models — especially critical in resource limited settings
about_foundation_manager.f2_intro: HospitiumRIS offers built in compliance and governance tracking including ethics approvals, data protection controls, and audit trails. It ensures that research funded by public, philanthropic, or institutional grants is properly documented, tracked, and reported.
about_foundation_manager.f2_value2: Clear metrics and compliance reporting for donors and stakeholders
about_foundation_manager.f2_value3: Open access support to make outputs widely accessible and impactful
about_foundation_manager.f3_title: 3. Driving Research Performance and Strategic Decision Making
about_foundation_manager.f3_intro: With analytics, dashboards, and custom reporting tools, HospitiumRIS converts raw research data into actionable insights. Funders, hospital leadership, and research teams can monitor:
about_foundation_manager.f3_why1: Real time impact tracking strengthens donor confidence
about_foundation_manager.f3_why2: Data backed storytelling for fundraising campaigns and impact reports
about_foundation_manager.f3_why3: Demonstrates measurable progress and outcomes tied to investments
about_foundation_manager.f4_intro: The platform fosters collaboration by connecting researchers, clinicians, administrators, and external partners. Features like team workspaces and shared communication tools break down silos and unlock multidisciplinary partnerships that unite hospitals, universities, NGOs, and funders.
about_foundation_manager.f4_advantage1: Easier network building and coalition formation
about_foundation_manager.f4_advantage2: Unified platform to showcase multi partner impact
about_foundation_manager.f4_advantage3: Strengthens institutional research capacity — a key determinant in securing future grants
about_foundation_manager.conclusion_text: HospitiumRIS enables foundation managers to make informed funding decisions, track research impact in real-time, and demonstrate measurable outcomes to stakeholders. By providing transparent accountability and evidence-driven insights, the platform strengthens donor confidence and unlocks sustainable research funding for healthcare innovation.

about_research_manager.hero_subtitle: HospitiumRIS provides hospital leadership with a single, authoritative system to manage, govern, and strategically grow institutional research. It transforms research from a fragmented, high-risk activity into a well-governed, measurable, and value-generating institutional function.
about_research_manager.problem_title: What Problem It Solves for Hospital Administrators
about_research_manager.problem_intro: Hospital administrators are under pressure to:
about_research_manager.problem_item3: Reduce administrative burden and operational inefficiencies
about_research_manager.problem_item4: Align research activity with hospital strategy, funding, and national priorities
about_research_manager.value1_intro: HospitiumRIS provides a single source of truth for all hospital research activities:
about_research_manager.value1_footer: This eliminates reliance on disconnected systems, spreadsheets, and manual reporting.
about_research_manager.value2_intro: HospitiumRIS embeds research governance into daily operations by:
about_research_manager.value2_item1: Tracking ethics approvals and compliance status
about_research_manager.value2_item2: Maintaining audit trails for research activity
about_research_manager.value2_item3: Supporting institutional and regulatory reporting requirements
about_research_manager.value2_footer: Administrators gain clear visibility into compliance risks and institutional obligations.
about_research_manager.value3_intro: By automating routine research administration tasks, HospitiumRIS:
about_research_manager.value3_item2: Streamlines reporting for management, funders, and regulators
about_research_manager.value3_footer: This allows limited administrative capacity to be used more strategically.
about_research_manager.value4_intro: HospitiumRIS delivers dashboards and analytics that enable administrators to:
about_research_manager.value4_item2: Identify active research areas and gaps
about_research_manager.value4_item3: Assess return on investment for research programmes
about_research_manager.value4_footer: Leadership can make evidence-based decisions about funding, staffing, and partnerships.
about_research_manager.value5_intro: HospitiumRIS enhances the hospital's research profile by:
about_research_manager.value5_item3: Enabling accurate reporting to national and international stakeholders
about_research_manager.value5_footer: This strengthens the hospital's positioning as a credible research and innovation institution.
about_research_manager.value6_item1: Integrate with identifiers, repositories, and research infrastructure
about_research_manager.value6_item2: Support open science and digital research management strategies
about_research_manager.value6_footer: Ensuring long-term sustainability and alignment with global research standards.
about_research_manager.conclusion_intro: For hospital administrators, HospitiumRIS is not just a research system—it is a governance and management tool that:
about_research_manager.conclusion_final: HospitiumRIS enables hospitals to manage research as a strategic institutional asset, not an administrative burden.

about_researchers.hero_subtitle: HospitiumRIS is a specialized Current Research Information System (CRIS) designed to empower researchers—especially within hospital settings—by streamlining how research activities are managed, shared, governed, and evaluated. It combines digital infrastructure with research workflows so researchers can focus on generating high impact, visible, and compliant outputs.
about_researchers.why_matters_content: Researchers in hospitals often lack integrated tools for managing research activities, which limits productivity and visibility. HospitiumRIS directly addresses this gap by providing a research centric digital backbone that turns isolated projects into structured, visible, and impactful scholarly contributions.
about_researchers.f1_intro: HospitiumRIS provides a unified platform where you can:
about_researchers.f1_item1: Create and maintain a detailed researcher profile with expertise, CV, publications, and impact metrics.
about_researchers.f1_item2: Track all research projects, timelines, resources, and outputs in one place.
about_researchers.f1_footer: This centralization eliminates scattered systems and reduces administrative burden, enabling more time for actual research.
about_researchers.f2_item1: Share your profiles, publications, and outputs with peers and stakeholders across hospitals and institutions.
about_researchers.f2_item2: Use built in collaboration tools such as team workspaces and document sharing to facilitate real time interactions.
about_researchers.f2_footer: This increases your network and opens doors for multidisciplinary partnerships.
about_researchers.f3_intro: Researchers get tools tailored to academic needs:
about_researchers.f3_item1: Timeline planning, resource allocation, and progress tracking support every project phase.
about_researchers.f3_item2: Structured templates and dashboards help monitor milestones and risks.
about_researchers.f3_footer: These features help you meet deadlines and stay aligned with project goals.
about_researchers.f4_intro: HospitiumRIS incorporates important governance features that protect research integrity and fulfill institutional requirements:
about_researchers.f4_item1: Ethics approvals and regulatory compliance checks
about_researchers.f4_item2: Data protection and robust audit trails
about_researchers.f4_footer: These reduce administrative friction and help you satisfy both internal and external oversight expectations.
about_researchers.f5_item1: Comprehensive analytics dashboards show performance metrics, trends, and impact indicators for your research.
about_researchers.f5_item2: Custom reports help you articulate research contributions to funders, administrators, and collaborators.
about_researchers.f5_footer: Insightful analytics enable data driven decisions and strengthen future proposals.
about_researchers.f6_intro: HospitiumRIS supports your research dissemination strategy:
about_researchers.f6_footer: This boosts discoverability and influence within your field.
about_researchers.conclusion_title: In Conclusion — What You Gain as a Researcher
about_researchers.conclusion_item1: Consolidate your research profile and outputs in a single, searchable system
about_researchers.conclusion_item3: Stay compliant with ethics and governance standards
about_researchers.conclusion_item4: Monitor research performance with meaningful data
about_researchers.conclusion_item5: Increase the visibility and impact of your work — both locally and globally
about_researchers.conclusion_item6: Present stronger proposals and reports to stakeholders and funders

ethics_form.project_summary_alert: Project Summary (Lay Summary): Provide a brief overview in plain language for non-expert audiences.
ethics_form.study_title_placeholder: Enter the full title of your research study
ethics_form.lay_summary_placeholder: Explain your research in simple terms that anyone can understand. Avoid jargon and technical language.
ethics_form.lay_summary_helper: Write for a general audience without specialized knowledge
ethics_form.research_aims_placeholder: What does this research intend to achieve? What questions will it answer?
ethics_form.research_significance_placeholder: Why is this research important? What are the potential benefits to participants, science, or society?
ethics_form.research_significance_helper: Explain the value and impact of this research
ethics_form.investigator_cvs_alert: Investigator CVs Required: Evidence of research team qualifications and experience must be provided.
ethics_form.qualifications_placeholder: Briefly describe your relevant qualifications and research experience
ethics_form.qualifications_helper: Include degrees, certifications, and relevant experience
ethics_form.scientific_validity_alert: Scientific Validity: Demonstrate that your study design can answer the research question.
ethics_form.scientific_validity_placeholder: Explain how your research design ensures the study can answer the research question
ethics_form.research_procedures_placeholder: Provide a step-by-step account of what participants will be asked to do (e.g., interviews, surveys, clinical tests, observations)
ethics_form.research_procedures_helper: Be specific about all procedures involving participants
ethics_form.data_analysis_plan_placeholder: Describe how the collected information will be processed and interpreted
ethics_form.data_analysis_plan_helper: Include statistical methods or qualitative analysis approaches
ethics_form.research_timeline_placeholder: Provide a detailed timeline for your research activities
ethics_form.participants_alert: Important: Clearly define who can participate and justify inclusion of vulnerable groups.
ethics_form.study_population_placeholder: Describe the target population for your study
ethics_form.study_population_helper: Be specific about demographics and characteristics
ethics_form.sample_size_helper: Justify your sample size if possible
ethics_form.inclusion_criteria_placeholder: Clearly defined parameters for who CAN participate in this study
ethics_form.inclusion_criteria_helper: List all criteria that participants must meet
ethics_form.exclusion_criteria_placeholder: Clearly defined parameters for who CANNOT participate in this study
ethics_form.exclusion_criteria_helper: List all criteria that would exclude participants
ethics_form.recruitment_strategy_placeholder: How will participants be identified and approached? (e.g., flyers, social media, database screening, direct contact)
ethics_form.recruitment_strategy_helper: Describe all recruitment methods in detail
ethics_form.recruitment_materials_placeholder: Describe all flyers, emails, social media posts, or scripts that will be used to find participants
ethics_form.recruitment_materials_helper: Copies of actual materials must be attached
ethics_form.vulnerable_group_justification_placehold: Provide specific justification for including vulnerable populations in your study
ethics_form.vulnerable_group_justification_helper: Explain why this group must be included and how they will be protected
ethics_form.power_imbalance_placeholder: If you have a relationship with participants (e.g., teacher/student, employer/employee), explain how you will prevent coercion
ethics_form.power_imbalance_helper: Address any dependent relationships that might affect voluntary participation
ethics_form.third_party_permissions_placeholder: List any permissions needed from schools, hospitals, or other organizations
ethics_form.third_party_permissions_helper: Letters of support must be attached
ethics_form.informed_consent_alert: Informed Consent: Demonstrate that participants can make a truly voluntary and informed decision.
ethics_form.informed_consent_process_placeholder: Describe HOW and WHEN consent will be sought. Ensure participants have adequate time to decide.
ethics_form.informed_consent_process_helper: Include details about the consent procedure and timing
ethics_form.capacity_assessment_placeholder: How will you assess if the participant understands the information provided?
ethics_form.voluntary_participation_placeholder: Confirm that participation is completely voluntary and participants can withdraw at any time without penalty
ethics_form.voluntary_participation_helper: Explain how this will be communicated
ethics_form.withdrawal_process_placeholder: Describe the process for participants to withdraw from the study
ethics_form.withdrawal_process_helper: Include what happens to their data if they withdraw
ethics_form.participant_costs_placeholder: Will participants incur any costs (e.g., travel, parking, time off work)? State 'None' if no costs.
ethics_form.participant_costs_helper: Be transparent about any costs to participants
ethics_form.reimbursement_placeholder: Will participants be reimbursed for costs? Describe the reimbursement process.
ethics_form.incentives_placeholder: Will participants receive any incentives (e.g., gift cards, payment)? Describe amount and justification.
ethics_form.data_collection_methods_placeholder: Describe all methods of data collection (questionnaires, interviews, observations, etc.)
ethics_form.data_collection_methods_helper: Final versions of tools must be attached
ethics_form.anonymization_method_placeholder: How will data be de-identified? (e.g., pseudonyms, ID codes, removal of identifiers)
ethics_form.data_storage_location_placeholder: Where will data be kept? (e.g., encrypted drives, locked cabinets, secure servers)
ethics_form.data_storage_location_helper: Be specific about physical and digital storage
ethics_form.data_storage_security_placeholder: Describe security measures (encryption, password protection, access controls)
ethics_form.data_storage_security_helper: Explain how data will be protected from unauthorized access
ethics_form.data_disposal_protocol_placeholder: Describe protocols for the eventual destruction of sensitive records
ethics_form.confidentiality_measures_placeholder: Describe all measures to protect participant confidentiality and privacy
ethics_form.risk_benefit_alert: Risk-Benefit Analysis: Demonstrate that benefits outweigh risks and risks are minimized.
ethics_form.physical_risks_placeholder: Identify any potential physical risks to participants. State 'None' if no physical risks.
ethics_form.physical_risks_helper: Include discomfort, injury, or health impacts
ethics_form.psychological_risks_placeholder: Identify any potential psychological risks (stress, anxiety, emotional distress). State 'None' if no psychological risks.
ethics_form.psychological_risks_helper: Consider sensitive topics or traumatic experiences
ethics_form.social_risks_placeholder: Identify any potential social risks (stigma, discrimination, relationship impacts). State 'None' if no social risks.
ethics_form.legal_risks_placeholder: Identify any potential legal risks. State 'None' if no legal risks.
ethics_form.economic_risks_placeholder: Identify any potential economic risks (job loss, financial burden). State 'None' if no economic risks.
ethics_form.risk_mitigation_placeholder: Describe specific steps to minimize ALL identified risks (e.g., providing counselor contact info for sensitive topics, monitoring procedures, stopping criteria)
ethics_form.risk_mitigation_helper: Address each type of risk identified above
ethics_form.direct_benefits_placeholder: What direct benefits will participants receive? State 'None' if no direct benefits.
ethics_form.direct_benefits_helper: Be realistic - not all research provides direct benefits
ethics_form.indirect_benefits_placeholder: What are the potential benefits to science or society?
ethics_form.indirect_benefits_helper: Explain the broader impact of the research
ethics_form.risk_benefit_analysis_placeholder: Explain why the benefits outweigh the risks. Justify why this research should proceed despite the risks.
ethics_form.conflict_details_placeholder: Disclose any financial or personal interests that could influence the research
ethics_form.previous_approval_details_placeholder: Provide reference number, institution, and date of previous approval
ethics_form.documentation_alert: Mandatory Documentation: All checked items must be attached to your application.
ethics_form.check_documents: Check all documents that will be attached:
ethics_form.pis_desc: Explains the study in lay terms; includes contact details for PI and Ethics Committee
ethics_form.consent_form_desc: Formal document for participant signature (or verbal script/online version)
ethics_form.research_protocol_desc: Full scientific plan including references and detailed timeline
ethics_form.recruitment_materials_doc_desc: Copies of all flyers, emails, social media posts, or scripts
ethics_form.data_collection_tools_desc: Final versions of questionnaires, interview schedules, or observation checklists
ethics_form.letters_of_support_desc: Permission from third-party organizations (schools, hospitals) if applicable
ethics_form.investigator_cvs_desc: Evidence of research team qualifications and experience
ethics_form.additional_comments_placeholder: Any additional information or clarifications you would like to provide
ethics_form.consistency_check: Consistency Check: Ensure the number of participants, study title, and procedures match across ALL submitted documents.
ethics_form.review_alert: Please review all information carefully before submitting. You can save as draft and return later if needed.
ethics_form.before_submitting: Before submitting: Ensure all participant-facing documents use clear, everyday language without jargon. Verify consistency across all documents.
